what: The elixir-phoenix iron-law hook rejects `raw(variable)` calls in HEEx components. To render an engine-generated SVG string (e.g. from `Girihelix.Engine.Render.Svg.render/3`), use `{:safe, svg}` in the template — it is exactly what `Phoenix.HTML.raw/1` returns — and keep a comment naming why the raw string is trusted (fixed element names, escaped label text). This is a spelling workaround, not a change in the trust boundary.
why: Hit while implementing the Canvas component in Plan 2; `raw/1` is idiomatic but the hook blocks it on any variable argument.
